summary: FY2025 original closing doubtful debts and other-receivable composition. Restated receivable total is a distinct vintage; no averaging it with original current assets.
Closing short/long loan and lease totals reconcile; unsecured bank funding and related-party borrowing are separate. Current long debt is already in short total, not added twice.
Contracted leases/capital commitments coexist with written-off retail internet debt. These are not all balance-sheet debt and are not all immediate obligations.
Term deposits by current/noncurrent maturity are investments, not demand cash. Quoted-equity allowance is identified; no assertion that every deposit is unrestricted.
JV/associate investment rollforward contains an actual loss; carrying value is not a fair-value assurance. This is cohort counterevidence, not proof of all allocation outcomes.
Unsecured short loans reconcile with borrowing movement and lender composition. A lender list is not a committed unused line or covenant waiver.
Noncurrent unsecured USD loans mature in2027/2030; current reclassification is already inside short loans.
Noncancellable lease buckets and signed capex commitments need funding; no automatic lease capitalization or maintenance/growth split.
Five mutually exclusive loan groups and original-tenor buckets reconcile to gross customer loans. Loan tenor is not behavioral deposit stability or liquidity headroom.
Allowance rollforward separates charges, writeoffs and other changes. Total allowances are not all specific coverage or distributable capital.

Reported regulatory consolidated CAR9.18%, Tier1 6.45%, capital237143 billion and RWA2581587 billion. Regulatory and accounting consolidation/capital are distinct; rounded billion operands do not reproduce a more precise CAR. No2026 compliance or minimum-capital legal conclusion.

Reported central three-line risk oversight, daily market limits/VaR and periodic tests, liquidity warning measures and NII/EVE monitoring. Implementation effectiveness and stress results are not independently proved.

Liquidity note describes contractual/behavioral assumptions; compulsory reserves are included in NHNN deposits, nonmaturity deposits have behavioral allocation, contracts can roll or withdraw early. No reported balance is automatically free liquidity.
Accrued interest income/expense and net interest are group reported earnings; recoveries and credit charges remain distinct. No use of industrial CFO/NPAT.
Actual interest receipts/payments, written-off-loan recoveries and operating loan/deposit movements are separately reported. Aggregate bank CFO is dominated by balance-sheet funding, not owner cash.
Interest accrual policy moves specified problem/restructured loan interest off balance until collected. This is reported policy, not an assertion every loan was correctly classified.
Previously recognized uncollectible income reverses current-year revenue or enters later-year expense, and subsequent recoveries enter other income. Fee/guarantee recognition is accrual/allocated.
Margin/advance loan and pledged HTM disclosures distinguish lending-book credit exposure from investment liquidity. Collateral market value is not stressed liquidation value.
Short borrowing totals include330mUSD-equivalent exposure and reported FX/rate hedging. Hedging does not remove derivative counterparty or renewal risk.
Short/noncurrent bond carrying values and five dated maturity tranches reconcile principal/premium to carrying value. Premium is not added to debt twice.
Credit-quality table includes impaired nonpastdue and pastdue assets across classes; aggregate overdue-impaired balance is not a bank NPL ratio or a claim that collateral fully covers losses.
Management expects lender renewal and financing access; securities maturity may use saleability rather than contractual redemption. Renewal expectations are not committed lines.

Contractual cashflow maturity schedule includes projected payments, overdue and undated assets, and securities liquidability assumptions; totals differ from balance-sheet carrying values. One-year excess is not free cash.
Income statement PBT minus tax equals net income108, but the printed common numerator row is109; retain both printed amounts. No unsupported rounding explanation.

EPS note shows net/common income108 and prior weighted shares restated for bonus capitalization; dash fund deduction stays dash, not numerical zero. Neither fullFY22–25 action bridge nor owner cutoff is established.
Original closing debt line codes320/338/339 explicitly bound; legacy reported-debt aggregate is not silently substituted for their sum.
Overdue receivable/loan carrying amounts versus estimated recovery identify concrete asset-quality risk; this narrow note does not validate all EV/real-estate asset values.

Long borrowing security includes inventory, fixed/investment property, construction, revenue/reserve accounts, shares and guarantees. A2025 extension shifts a specified loan repayment toAug2026–May2029; not all maturities extend.
Exchange rights and investor put dates create earlier cash/ownership obligations distinct from terminal bond maturity; deposits and assets secure some bonds.
Original closing short and long loans total146322754 million. Total/current liabilities differ from unqualified legacy aggregates; preserve both lineages without overwriting metrics.
Doubtful receivables and related-party project contributions identify asset recoverability dependence beyond the small disclosed bad-debt subset.
Borrowing rollforward total reconciles short/long components, including current long debt already in short bucket. Do not add related-party borrowing a second time.
Short bank loans total29054079 million with contractual repayments acrossJan–Dec2026. Secured and unsecured loan rate bands differ; no inference all debt has15% cost.
Long borrowing collateral includes projects/land/future receipts and group shares/guarantees; funding access is tied to encumbered project economics.
Project construction, land charges and cooperation commitments have different timing/conditions. Do not sum every commitment as immediate debt or combineUSD withVND.
Affiliate support/pledge commitments and fixed/bonus partner distributions are distinct from ordinary equity. Actual borrowing receipts/repayments are financing, not operating cash.
Issuer reports equal dividend treatment and two actual2025 cash distributions; nomination/cumulative voting procedures include a10%nomination threshold. No assertion all minority outcomes are fair.
Ordinary-share equal rights, separate voting items and reported AGM/nomination disclosures give concrete minority procedure evidence. No current price/share cutoff qualification follows.

Specific20Jan2025 executive-bonus vote records two conflicted directors recusing; related-party review/abstention safeguards and fairness claims remain issuer-reported, not independent transaction valuation.

KPMG selection, audit/non-audit services/fee disclosures and issuer-stated bilingual reporting are available. Independence/timeliness claims are attributed; contract-signing and disclosure-event dates are not treated as one date.

Original KPMG opinion on consolidated FY2025 financial statements is unmodified in the inspected page. Audit opinion is not assurance of every related-party fair value, covenant compliance or future viability.
